items.title_zh: 微软砍掉不成功的AI功能，合并独立的Copilot应用
items.title_en: Microsoft kills off unsuccessful AI features while merging its separate Copilot apps
items.summary_zh: 微软宣布对Copilot产品线进行简化，将面向消费者和企业的独立Copilot应用合并为一个统一的体验。同时，公司将停止支持多个未达预期的AI功能，包括AI生成的播客、群组聊天、深度研究功能以及Mico虚拟角色。这一整合旨在减少产品碎片化，提升用户体验的一致性与易用性。合并后的应用将更专注于核心AI助手能力，但现有依赖这些功能的使用者可能需要适应新的产品形态。此举也反映出微软在AI战略上的务实调整。
items.summary_en: Microsoft is simplifying Copilot by combining its consumer and business apps, and dropping AI-generated podcasts, Group Chats, Deep Research, and its Mico character.
items.why_zh: 这表明微软正收缩AI功能范围，聚焦于核心Copilot体验，以提升产品竞争力和用户满意度。
items.why_en: This shows Microsoft is prioritizing a cohesive Copilot experience over experimental features, potentially redefining its AI assistant strategy.

items.title_zh: 三星首款 Galaxy 头戴耳机曝光，预计 2027 年初正面挑战苹果 AirPods Max
items.title_en: Samsung's First Galaxy Over-Ear Headphones Leak, Aiming at AirPods Max in Early 2027
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 13 日消息，SamMobile 发现，三星正在研发其首款 Galaxy 品牌头戴式无线耳机，内部代号为“Galaxy H1”。这款产品将直接对标苹果 AirPods Max，预计于 2027 年初正式发布。 目前三星 Galaxy Wearable 应用中已经加入了关于这款产品的代码，还包含图标轮廓。其外形采用宽头梁设计，风格类似苹果 AirPods Max，而耳罩部分则相对更厚，类似索尼 WH-1000XM6 的设计语言。图标展示了白、灰、黑三种配色，耳罩衬垫则有灰色与绿色可选。 功能方面，尽管具体硬件规格尚未确认，但 SamMobile 预测 Galaxy H1 将支持蓝牙 6.0 连接、三星无缝超高音质（SSC UHQ）音频编解码器、自适应主动降噪（ANC）、环境音模式、AI 助手集成以及自动切换（Auto Switch）功能，并有望提供远超 Galaxy Buds 系列的续航能力。 三星目前拥有 JBL、AKG 和 Harman Kardon 等多个音频品牌，但 Galaxy H1 将是三星首次以 Galaxy 品牌推出头戴式耳机产品。IT之家后续将保持关注。 相关阅读： 《 三星电子将宝华韦健、天龙收入麾下：哈曼完成对 Sound United 收购 》
items.summary_en: Samsung is reportedly developing its first Galaxy-branded over-ear wireless headphones, codenamed "Galaxy H1", targeting the Apple AirPods Max with a projected launch in early 2027. The device may feature Bluetooth 6.0, Samsung's SSC UHQ codec, adaptive ANC, ambient sound mode, AI assistant integration, and auto switch, with a design blending AirPods Max-like headband and Sony WH-1000XM6-style ear cups. It would mark Samsung's first entry into the over-ear headphone market under the Galaxy brand.
items.why_zh: 三星以自有品牌进军高端头戴耳机市场，将直接与苹果和索尼展开竞争，丰富其音频产品生态。
items.why_en: This marks Samsung's debut in premium over-ear headphones under its Galaxy brand, intensifying rivalry with Apple and Sony in the audio segment.

items.title_zh: 传音推出 TECNO Pova 8 Pro 手机：灵感来自星际飞船，配个性化点阵背屏
items.title_en: TECNO Launches Pova 8 Pro with Starship-Inspired Design and Customizable Dot-Matrix Back Display
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 13 日消息，据外媒 GSMarena 今天（13 日）晚间报道，传音旗下品牌 TECNO 正式发布了此前已经多次曝光的 Pova 8 Pro。 TECNO Pova 8 Pro 搭载 天玑 7400 Ultimate 芯片 ，最高提供 12GB 内存和 512GB 存储空间，并额外配备 P1 图形芯片提升游戏表现。通过游戏插帧，部分游戏可以实现 144 帧运行。其中 RPG 游戏最高支持 90 帧，FPS 和 MOBA 游戏最高支持 144 帧。 系统方面，Pova 8 Pro 预装基于 Android 16 开发的 HiOS 16，TECNO 承诺提供两次大版本升级和三年安全补丁。Pova 8 Pro 还集成 TECNO AI 和数字助理 Ella，并提供多项 AI 生产力和摄影功能。 手机正面配备 6.78 英寸 144Hz HyperLux AMOLED 屏幕 ，覆盖康宁大猩猩玻璃 7i，峰值亮度达到 4500 尼特，分辨率为 2644×1208 像素，瞬时触控采样率达到 2800Hz。屏幕还支持湿手和油手触控，手指沾水或沾油时依然可以正常操作。 Pova 8 Pro 背面的三角形相机模组内还加入了一块 Alive Matrix 点阵式显示屏，采用 Mini LED 技术，显示内容可以自定义。整个背部造型被 TECNO 称为“星际飞船设计”， 灵感来自星际…
items.summary_en: TECNO has unveiled the Pova 8 Pro, powered by the Dimensity 7400 Ultimate chip with up to 12GB RAM and 512GB storage, plus a P1 graphics chip for game frame interpolation, enabling up to 144fps in select games. It runs HiOS 16 based on Android 16, featuring TECNO AI and assistant Ella. The 6.78-inch 144Hz AMOLED display offers 4500-nit peak brightness and wet/oil touch support, while the back houses a customizable Mini LED dot-matrix display called Alive Matrix, part of the "Starship Design".
items.why_zh: 传音将AI功能与独特背屏设计下放到中端机型，展现了差异化竞争策略和AI技术普及趋势。
items.why_en: TECNO's integration of AI features and a novel back display in a mid-range phone showcases its differentiation strategy and the trend of AI democratization.

The update enhances agent capabilities and adds native support for OpenAI's Responses API format, including Codex adaptation. API pricing will adopt peak/off-peak rates with off-peak at 50%, effective August 17, 2026.

items.summary_en: Google DeepMind's restructuring follows a two-month delay of Gemini, which still trails rivals in coding due to internal conflicts and compute constraints. Co-founder Sergey Brin has intervened to prioritize AI development.
items.why_zh: 这揭示了谷歌在AI竞赛中因组织与算力问题导致进展受阻，凸显其与OpenAI等对手的差距拉大风险。
items.why_en: It exposes Google's organizational and compute bottlenecks in the AI race, risking further gap with rivals like OpenAI.

items.title_zh: 迟来 6 个月的惊喜：《以撒的结合》作者独立游戏新作《喵喵的结合》简体中文翻译开启公测

items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 13 日消息，热门战旗类 RPG 独立游戏《喵喵的结合》宣布游戏简体中文翻译已正式开启公测，一旦官方确保翻译完善后将加入正式版中。与之一同上线的还有日文、韩文以及俄文翻译。 公开信息显示，《喵喵的结合》是由传奇肉鸽游戏《以撒的结合》作者 Edmund McMillen（E 胖）与平台冒险游戏《终结将至》作者 Tyler Glaiel 合作打造的战旗类 RPG 肉鸽。游戏于今年 2 月发售，短短几天销量便轻松破百万，但由于缺少简体中文，让许多玩家望而却步。 而在 6 个月后的今天，游戏简体中文翻译正式发布，意味着本作有望迎来新一波国内玩家浪潮，IT之家附游戏商品页（ https://store.steampowered.com/app/686060/_/ ）。 在本作中，玩家将扮演被科学家复活的怪人，组建培养自己的猫咪大军，派他们踏上颇具深度和难度的回合制冒险之旅。游戏体量庞大，拥有超过 200 小时的主线流程，十几个平均拥有 75 项不同技能的职业，900 多种物品，200 多种敌人和头目以及轻度类 Rogue 的成长机制，每一局游戏都大不相同。
items.summary_en: The Chinese Simplified translation for the popular turn-based RPG roguelike 'Miaomiao's Union' has entered public beta, developer announced on Aug 13. The game, created by Edmund McMillen (The Binding of Isaac) and Tyler Glaiel, sold over a million copies within days of its February launch but lacked Chinese support. The beta also includes Japanese, Korean, and Russian translations, with the final version expected to attract many Chinese players.
items.why_zh: 中文公测将消除语言障碍，为该作在华玩家的大规模涌入提供契机。
items.why_en: The Chinese localization beta removes language barriers, paving the way for a significant influx of Chinese players.

items.title_zh: 英国研究多种防范措施，避免恐怖分子利用 AI 制造生物武器

items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 13 日消息，据彭博社 12 日报道，英国政府准备监管人工智能在基因合成领域的应用。随着官员对生物安全风险的担忧不断加深，英国政府认为，如果全球缺少有效监管， AI 可能降低制造生物武器的门槛 。 据知情人士透露，英国政府正在研究多种防范措施，避免 恐怖分子、其他恶意行为者或疏忽大意的研究人员 利用基因合成制造合成 DNA。 待定的措施中，包括制定新的生物武器法律。一种方案是修改现行法律，建立基因合成筛查制度。实验室需要确认客户是否为合法用户，一旦发现异常情况就必须通知主管部门，例如有人要求合成可能引发安全担忧的 DNA 序列。 英国政府还在研究，是否需要以及应在多大程度上介入 AI 企业与学术机构之间的合作。据悉，目前有部分学术机构专门研究基因组测序，并掌握大量基因组测序数据。 这种威胁具有全球性，因此英国单方面监管能够取得的效果有限。要让措施真正发挥作用，还需要与全球其他主要基因合成中心协调实施。 据IT之家了解，英国提出监管方案之际，科技界和科学界近几个月不断警告 AI 可能带来的生物安全风险 ，政府官员也越来越担忧恶意团体或个人要求 AI 模型编写基因序列，再利用这些序列制造危险病原体。 英国政府发言人表示：“我们正在密切监测新兴技术带来的风险，也始终在积极评估是否还需要采取更多措施。为了保障公众安全， 我们会采取一切必要行动 。” 英国对 AI 监管采取…
items.summary_en: The UK government is moving to regulate AI in gene synthesis, fearing it could lower the barrier for bioweapon creation. items.summary_en: According to Sina Finance, Unitree's IPO highlights a battle over the AI 'brain' of robots. The company appears to rely on both NVIDIA for computing power and DeepSeek for models, reflecting a dual-track strategy in a fiercely competitive robotics AI landscape.
items.why_zh: 机器人龙头在AI“大脑”上的选边，可能决定未来人形机器人技术生态的走向。
items.why_en: How leading robot makers choose their AI 'brain' could shape the future ecosystem of humanoid robotics.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek深夜上线新模型V4pro，没涨价，还招人
items.title_en: DeepSeek launches V4 Pro at night, keeps prices and starts hiring
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek深夜上线新模型V4pro，没涨价，还招人 Sohu
items.summary_en: DeepSeek quietly released its new V4 Pro model late at night, keeping prices unchanged and simultaneously posting job openings. The move signals a focus on user retention and talent accumulation amid intense AI competition.
items.why_zh: 在模型价格战愈演愈烈之际，DeepSeek坚持不涨价并扩张团队，显示出以规模和生态取胜的战略意图。
items.why_en: As the AI model price war intensifies, DeepSeek's decision to keep prices and hire signals a scale-and-ecosystem strategy.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Pro正式版上线，中证科创创业50指数盘中最高涨超2%
items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Pro launch lifts CSE 50 Index over 2% intraday
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek-V4-Pro正式版上线，中证科创创业50指数盘中最高涨超2% Jiemian.com
items.summary_en: The launch of DeepSeek V4 Pro sent the CSI Innovation & Entrepreneurship 50 Index up more than 2% at its intraday high, reflecting strong market optimism about domestic AI model advances. The gain underscores the growing influence of AI releases on tech stock sentiment.
items.why_zh: 国产大模型发布直接刺激科创指数，凸显AI技术突破对资本市场的定价作用。
items.why_en: It highlights that domestic AI model launches can now directly drive tech-stock valuations.

items.title_zh: 全球调用量前五全是我国模型——OpenAI降了80%的价，为什么还是追不上？
items.title_en: Top 5 most-called AI models are all Chinese; why can't OpenAI catch up with an 80% price cut?
items.summary_zh: 全球调用量前五全是我国模型——OpenAI降了80%的价，为什么还是追不上？ thepaper.cn
items.summary_en: According to The Paper, all top five most-called AI models globally are Chinese, and OpenAI's 80% price cut has not changed this. It suggests Chinese models now lead in real-world usage and ecosystem adoption.
items.why_zh: 调用量作为真实使用指标，其排名变化表明中国AI模型在全球市场的实际影响力已领先。
items.why_en: The call-volume ranking reflects China's lead in real-world AI adoption, not just benchmark performance.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek V4 Pro正式发布，大数据ETF华夏（516000）涨超3%
items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Pro release sends Big Data ETF (516000) up over 3%

items.summary_en: The official release of DeepSeek V4 Pro pushed the Big Data ETF (516000) up over 3% during trading, showing investors' strong appetite for AI-driven tech plays. The move mirrors a broader pattern where AI model launches catalyze sector-wide rallies.
items.why_zh: AI模型发布直接带动大数据ETF大涨，显示国产AI创新对相关产业投资的强大催化效应。
items.why_en: The ETF rally underscores the powerful catalytic effect of domestic AI model releases on related investments.

items.title_zh: 美团、淘宝闪购、京东外卖三家平台率先集中在京落地“红灯停表”
items.title_en: Meituan, Taobao Flash, and JD Waimai Take the Lead in Implementing 'Red Light Pause' in Beijing
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 13 日消息，据央视新闻今日报道，平台经济“破卷向善”第二次协商对话于今日（8 月 13 日）在京召开。 京沪两地市场监管部门围绕外卖骑手算法优化， 组织三家外卖平台与骑手共商共治 ，同时邀请专家学者、人大代表等多方协商优化举措，进一步保护外卖骑手合法权益，推动行业从“速度竞赛”转向“质量竞争”，围绕算法评估优化、加强管理引导、常态化协商共治等三方面推出一系列措施。 算法评估优化方面 ，美团、淘宝闪购、京东外卖三家平台将率先集中在京落地“红灯停表”，骑手等红灯的时长在考核时间中顺延。保障转单场景下骑手配送时长，适度增加骑手配送考核时长；计算配送时长时，对于驾驶电动自行车配送的情况，以平均时速不超过 15 公里 / 小时计算；对恶劣天气、复杂路况等加大补时力度。科学设置商家列表首页显示的配送参考送达时长，避免“分钟级竞速”。因商家出餐慢导致的超时订单，不影响骑手服务分。 加强管理引导方面 ，开展“智慧骑手”行动，探索开发骑手 AI 智能体助手，为骑手提供优惠智能设备。加大安全分正向激励作用，营造遵规守法良好风尚。加大技术力量投入，强化交通违法行为监测，引导骑手安全行驶并按规定停放车辆。 协商共治方面 ，围绕骑手算法常态化开展“破卷向善”协商对话，履行算法备案手续并主动公开，组织算法宣讲与答疑活动，提升算法透明度。 京沪两地市场监管部门相关负责人表示，将继续发挥多方协…
items.summary_en: At the second negotiation on the platform economy, regulators from Beijing and Shanghai brought together Meituan, Taobao Flash, and JD Waimai to optimize delivery algorithms. The three platforms will take the lead in implementing a 'red light pause' in Beijing, with red-light waiting time excluded from assessment. They will also increase delivery time allowances, assume an average speed not exceeding 15 km/h for e-bikes, and explore AI assistant tools for riders, signaling a shift from speed competition to quality.
items.why_zh: 三大外卖平台率先将骑手算法优化细化为具体规则，对全行业提升骑手权益和算法透明度具有示范意义。
items.why_en: The three leading delivery platforms are turning algorithm optimization into concrete, enforceable rules, setting an example for the industry to improve rider welfare and algorithmic transparency.

items.title_zh: 摩根州立大学推出人工智能学位，含量子机器学习课程
items.title_en: Morgan State University Launches Artificial Intelligence Degree With Quantum Machine Learning Courses
items.summary_zh: 摩根州立大学宣布推出全新的人工智能学位项目，并包含量子机器学习课程。该项目将AI与量子计算内容结合，培养跨学科人才。目前关于学位层次、课程体系与招生安排的具体细节尚未公布。
items.summary_en: Morgan State University Launches Artificial Intelligence Degree With Quantum Machine Learning Courses NCHStats
items.why_zh: 这是高校把量子机器学习纳入AI学位教育的又一案例，反映了AI学科与量子计算交叉融合的趋势。
items.why_en: This move reflects the growing intersection of AI and quantum computing in higher education, preparing students for future AI infrastructure demands.

items.title_zh: Anthropic洽谈以60亿美元收购以色列AI初创公司Decart
items.title_en: Anthropic in talks to acquire Israeli AI startup Decart for $6 billion

items.summary_en: Anthropic in talks to acquire Israeli AI startup Decart for $6 billion calcalistech.com
items.why_zh: 潜在收购若成行，将大幅扩充Anthropic的技术与人才储备，加剧AI大模型公司之间的资源争夺。
items.why_en: If completed, the acquisition would significantly expand Anthropic's technology and talent resources, intensifying competition among AI labs.

items.title_zh: 韩国 AI 模型 Solar Pro 4 首次亮相 Agent Arena：排名 44，与 MiniMax M2.7 同级
items.title_en: South Korean AI Model Solar Pro 4 Debuts on Agent Arena, Ranking 44 Alongside MiniMax M2.7
items.summary_zh: IT之家 8 月 13 日消息，韩国人工智能实验室 Upstage 今天（8 月 13 日）发布博文， 宣布推出 Solar Pro 4 模型，定位为面向复杂 AI 智能体任务的商用大模型。 Solar Pro 4 模型上下文窗口为 512K，最高输出长度为 128K token，支持用户在单次会话中加载多份合同、报告和数据文件，官方博文中暂未披露参数量相关信息。 定价方面，IT之家援引博文介绍，附上相关信息如下： 每 100 万 Tokens 输入价格为 0.3 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2 元人民币） 缓存读取（Cache Read）每 100 万 Tokens 输入价格为 0.06 美元 （现汇率约合 0.41 元人民币） 每 100 万 Tokens 输出价格为 1.2 美元 （现汇率约合 8.1 元人民币） 智能体任务方面，Solar Pro 4 的主要提升集中在更接近真实工作的评测上，包括长文档、终端任务和多轮工具调用。官方列出的 3 项核心结果为：Terminal-Bench v2.1 得分 57，τ³-Banking 得分 23，AA-LCR 得分 71。 Upstage 以虚构咖啡品牌 Solarbean Coffee 的门店选址分析作为演示任务。输入材料包括 1 份门店开设政策文档和 6 份市场数据文件。 Solar Pro 4 在 3 条提示词内完成 1…
items.summary_en: Upstage has released Solar Pro 4, a commercial AI model with a 512K context window and 128K max output, priced at $0.3 per million input tokens and $1.2 per million output tokens. It debuted at rank 44 on Agent Arena, on par with MiniMax M2.7, and scored 57 on Terminal-Bench v2.1, 23 on τ³-Banking, and 71 on AA-LCR, demonstrating strong agentic capabilities.
items.why_zh: Solar Pro 4以长上下文和较低定价切入智能体场景，显示韩国AI模型已具备与一线模型在Agent基准上竞争的实力。
items.why_en: Solar Pro 4 shows that South Korean AI models can compete with leading systems on agent benchmarks, offering a long context window and competitive pricing.

items.title_zh: 联想集团 2026 财年第一财季归母亏损 6.09 亿美元，同比由盈转亏

items.summary_en: Lenovo reported FY2026 first-quarter revenue of $26.94 billion, up 43% year over year, with a gross margin of 16.5%. It posted a net loss attributable to shareholders of $609 million, swinging from a profit. AI-related revenue rose 60% to $8.5 billion, accounting for 35% of total revenue, while adjusted profit attributable to shareholders jumped 176% to $1.075 billion.
items.why_zh: 尽管报表层面亏损，AI相关收入已占集团总收入35%，显示联想正加速兑现AI驱动的增长逻辑，盈利结构出现明显变化。
items.why_en: Despite the reported loss, AI-related revenue now makes up 35% of total revenue, indicating Lenovo's AI-driven growth strategy is taking effect and reshaping its earnings profile.

items.title_zh: VQ-bench：一个可组合的向量量化框架
items.title_en: VQ-bench: A Composable Vector Quantization Framework
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文针对向量量化提出统一的开发与基准测试框架。作者定义了7种常见的量化原语，并展示如何将它们任意组合；同时将25种常见量化器重新表达为这些原语的流水线。为促进社区扩展和复现，作者开源了VQ-bench基准。论文指出，向量量化虽是一个经典问题，但近期已成为AI基础设施的核心技术。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11240v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Vector quantization is an old problem but has recently become central to AI infrastructure. It is therefore experiencing a surge of renewed engineering and research activity. This paper provides a unified framework for developing and benchmarking new quantization algorithms. We describe 7 common conceptual quantization primitives and show how to compose them arbitrarily. We then re-express 25 common quantizers as pipelines of these primitives. Finally, we publish VQ-bench as open-source to be extended further and make reproducible benchmarks publ…
items.why_zh: 随着向量量化在AI基础设施中愈发关键，该框架有望统一量化算法的描述与评测，加快相关研究和工程落地。
items.why_en: As vector quantization becomes more central to AI infrastructure, this framework may standardize how quantization algorithms are described and benchmarked, accelerating research and deployment.

items.title_zh: 前沿LLM能否媲美原生多模态嵌入？硬负样本图文检索对比研究
items.title_en: Can Frontier LLMs Match Natively Multimodal Embeddings? A Comparison on Hard-Negative Text-to-Image Retrieval
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文研究多模态检索场景中，前沿大语言模型（LLM）与原生多模态嵌入模型（如谷歌2026年3月发布的Gemini Embedding 2）在硬负样本文本到图像检索上的表现。传统方法依赖双编码器通过对比学习对齐视觉和文本表征，而Gemini Embedding 2可将文本、图像、视频、音频和文档映射到同一共享空间，加剧了检索系统的竞争。论文重点对比这两类模型在困难负样本下的检索能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11343v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal retrieval and classification across different types of media, spanning text, images,video and audio, has traditionally relied on dual-encoder models that align visual and textual representations through contrastive learning. The March 2026 release of Gemini Embedding 2, Google's first natively multimodal embedding model to map text, images, video, audio, and documents into a single shared space, raises competition among multimodal retrieval systems. Simultaneously, frontier Large language models (LLMs) have also demonstrated strong vis…
items.why_zh: 该研究的结果将直接影响多模态检索系统是选择专用嵌入模型还是通用LLM，对AI应用架构设计具有实际参考价值。
items.why_en: The findings could influence whether multimodal retrieval systems should rely on specialized embedding models or general-purpose LLMs, with practical implications for AI architecture design.

items.title_zh: OEIS Open：语言模型能将多少猜想变成定理？
items.title_en: OEIS Open: How many conjectures can language models turn into theorems?
items.summary_zh: 研究人员构建了OEIS Open基准，包含492个来自OEIS的开放数学猜想，并用Lean形式化。之前这些猜想仅由专门智能体尝试，现在开源评估代码允许通用语言模型运行，并防止作弊。使用最小工具集的语言模型在每次尝试50美元预算下解决了147个猜想（30%）。另外提供OEIS Open Lite，即100个猜想的随机子集，用于更便宜的评估。这展示了语言模型在自动定理证明方面的潜力，但也揭示了当前方法的成本与局限性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We construct OEIS Open, a benchmark based on 492 open mathematical conjectures from the OEIS, formalized in Lean by Tsoukalas et al. Whereas these conjectures had previously been attempted only with a bespoke agent, our open-source evaluation code runs any generic language model (LM) against them, and is secure against LM cheating attempts. We find that LMs equipped with a minimal set of tools resolve 147 of these conjectures with a budget of \$50 per attempt, scoring 30% on OEIS Open. OEIS Open Lite is a random subset of 100 conjectures for chea…
items.why_zh: 该基准首次让通用语言模型可被公平评估于开放数学猜想证明，为衡量和推动自动定理证明能力提供了标准化测试。
items.why_en: It provides an open, cheat-resistant benchmark to fairly assess generic LMs on open conjectures, accelerating research in automated theorem proving.

items.title_zh: 自演化网络验证器
items.title_en: Self-evolving network verifiers
items.summary_zh: 符号网络验证器可以在大量路由输入和故障上推理正确性，但仅适用于专家手工编码的协议和特性。由于没有书面规范能完美描述网络行为（厂商实现偏离RFC，行为随版本变化），创建和维护控制平面的忠实模型极其困难且永无止境。这种持续维护的负担使许多需要验证的网络无法使用验证技术。作者提出模型应该自我演化，以减轻手工维护负担。如果实现，将大幅降低网络验证的准入门槛。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11340v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Symbolic network verifiers can reason about correctness across vast spaces of routing inputs and failures, but only for the protocols and features an expert has encoded by hand. Creating and maintaining a faithful model of the control plane is both difficult and never-ending, since no written source specifies perfectly what a network does: vendor implementations deviate from the RFCs, and behaviour shifts with releases. The burden of constant upkeep ultimately keeps verification out of many networks that need it. We argue that the model should…
items.why_zh: 提出自我演化模型可能让网络验证摆脱手工编码瓶颈，使更多网络能获得形式化验证保障。
items.why_en: Self-evolving models could remove the manual-encoding bottleneck, making formal verification accessible to more networks.

items.title_zh: 学习说服暴露LLM多易放弃正确信念
items.title_en: Learning to Persuade Exposes How Easily LLMs Abandon Correct Beliefs
items.summary_zh: 说服是语言交流的核心动态，影响LLM如何更新信念、解决分歧和做决策。随着LLM越来越多地与人类和彼此辩论、建议和协作思考，抵抗有害说服成为可靠行为的关键要求。但研究表明这一要求远远没有达到：一个单一的有针对性的说服论点就足以将模型准确率降到接近零，即使该论点事实错误。研究者将此威胁形式化，并可能提出防御方法。这揭示了LLM在对抗性说服面前的脆弱性，对实际部署构成风险。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11624v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Persuasion is a core dynamic of natural language communication, shaping how large language models (LLMs) update beliefs, resolve disagreements, and reach decisions. As LLMs increasingly debate, advise, and think collaboratively with humans and each other, resistance to harmful persuasion becomes a core requirement for reliable behavior. Yet we show that this requirement is far from met: a single targeted persuasive argument is enough to collapse model accuracy to near zero, even when the argument is factually false. We formalize this threat as…
items.why_zh: 揭示了LLM在有害说服面前的严重脆弱性，挑战其作为可靠决策伙伴的适用性。
items.why_en: It exposes a critical vulnerability of LLMs to harmful persuasion, questioning their reliability in collaborative decision-making.

items.title_zh: 双量子比特激发门的12-CNOT分解
items.title_en: A 12-CNOT Double Qubit Excitation Gate
items.summary_zh: 高效实现高级量子门对实用量子计算至关重要。该论文首次提出双量子比特激发算子的12-CNOT分解，优于先前最佳实现的13个CNOT。新电路具有最低的CNOT数（12）、最低CNOT深度（10）和最低总电路深度（16），同时相比先前最低单比特门数（11）只增加了2个额外单比特门。这一优化显著降低了电路复杂度，为量子算法的实际部署提供了更高效的实现方式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11733v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Effective implementation of high-level quantum gates is essential for practical quantum computing. To the best of our knowledge, we present the first reported 12-CNOT decomposition of the double qubit excitation operator, improving upon state-of-the-art (SOTA) implementations with 13 CNOTs. Our new circuit has the lowest CNOT count (12), lowest CNOT depth (10), and lowest total circuit depth (16) among all the previous SOTA circuits. Further, we only added 2 extra one-qubit gates compared to the lowest one-qubit gate count (11) among the previo…
items.why_zh: 新颖的12-CNOT分解降低了量子电路复杂度，是朝向更高效量子计算的重要一步。
items.why_en: The new 12-CNOT decomposition reduces circuit complexity, advancing more efficient quantum computing.

items.title_zh: 基于基准的印度基础模型比较评估：能力与评估成熟度框架
items.title_en: Benchmark-Based Comparative Assessment of Publicly Benchmarked Indian Foundation Models: A Capability and Evaluation-Maturity Framework
items.summary_zh: 政府越来越多地资助本土基础模型以增强国家AI能力、数字主权和多语言计算。然而，评估这些国家生态系统的进展因基准报告不一致、专有评估方法和快速演变的模型发布而变得复杂。该论文提出了一个结构化的、基于基准的比较评估框架，对公开基准测试的印度基础模型与全球前沿及类似规模模型进行了八个能力领域的比较，包括通用推理等。该框架有助于更系统地衡量本土模型的能力和评估成熟度。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11891v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Governments increasingly fund indigenous foundation models to strengthen national AI capability, digital sovereignty, and multilingual computing. Assessing the progress of such national ecosystems is complicated by inconsistent benchmark reporting, proprietary evaluation methodologies, and rapidly evolving model releases. This paper presents a structured, benchmark-based comparative assessment of publicly benchmarked Indian foundation models against global frontier and comparable-scale models, across eight capability domains: general-purpose re…
items.why_zh: 为评估国家级基础模型生态系统提供了系统化框架，有助于政策制定和投资决策。
items.why_en: It offers a systematic framework to assess national AI model ecosystems, aiding policy and investment decisions.

items.title_zh: 群污染结构化结果的因果推断：可观测商、无损约简与精确随机化推断
items.title_en: Causal inference for group-contaminated structured outcomes: observable quotients, lossless reduction and exact randomization inference
items.summary_zh: 结构化潜在结果（如显微镜图像）可能在未知的、单位特定的变换后被记录。如果该变换依赖于治疗、协变量或内在结果，基于原始坐标的分析可能将生物效应与采集几何混淆。作者研究了无限制观测模型X = Γ·Y(A)，刻画了其可观测信息：一个目标在群轨道上为常数时才可均匀恢复，而Borel最大不变量保留每个可测不变目标。该研究为存在未知变换的复杂结果提供了因果推断理论，有助于在高维结构化数据中避免混杂偏差。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11954v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Structured potential outcomes such as microscopy images may be recorded after an unknown, unit-specific transformation. If that transformation can depend on treatment, covariates or the intrinsic outcome, raw-coordinate analyses may mix biological effects with acquisition geometry. We study the unrestricted observation model X = {\Gamma} . Y(A) and characterize its observable information: a target is uniformly recoverable exactly when it is constant on group orbits, while a Borel maximal invariant retains every measurable invariant target. We t…
items.why_zh: 为处理未知变换下的复杂结构化结果提供了因果推断的理论基础，避免混杂偏差。
items.why_en: It provides theoretical foundations for causal inference with unknown transformed structured outcomes, preventing confounding biases.

items.title_zh: Ready Cohorts：限制GPU机会并避免LLM智能体控制中的主机往返
items.title_en: Ready Cohorts: Bounding GPU Opportunity and Avoiding Host Round Trips in LLM-Agent Control
items.summary_zh: LLM智能体服务在模型和工具调用之间重复执行小的确定性转换，如路由结果、更新状态和发出下一个效果。作者研究这条控制路径何时能暴露足够的并发工作供GPU执行，以及当GPU计算的路径决策留在设备上时会有什么变化。他们使用固定分区份额F、精确离线份额P*、局部上界U和在线实现份额A来形式化ready-cohort边界。在零服务时间、无限容量和相等相对启动截止时间的条件下，一个专门的调度策略可以限制GPU机会并减少主机往返。这为LLM智能体系统的高效执行提供了理论指导。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12123v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM-agent services repeatedly execute small deterministic transitions between model and tool calls: route an outcome, update state, and emit the next effect. We ask when this control path exposes enough concurrent work for GPU execution, and what changes when a GPU-computed route decision remains on device. We formalize the ready-cohort boundary using fixed-partition share F, exact offline share P*, local upper bound U, and online achieved share A. Under zero service time, unlimited capacity, and equal relative launch deadlines, a specialized d…
items.why_zh: 为优化LLM智能体系统中的GPU利用率和延迟提供了理论框架。
items.why_en: It provides a theoretical framework for optimizing GPU utilization and latency in LLM-agent systems.

items.title_zh: 人机替代原则：组织中你何时会被AI替代？
items.title_en: The Human-AI Substitution Principle: When will you be replaced by AI in your organization?
items.summary_zh: AI正迅速改变组织，提出了一个根本性的组织与经济问题：人类员工何时会被AI替代？作者提出一个分析模型，研究层级组织中的人-AI任务分配（HAT）。HAT模型的核心特征是正式编码了人类技能获取与AI能力扩展之间的经济不对称性。该模型可以推导风险调整成本、技能、组织深度、部署规模、战略适应等因素如何影响替代时间点。这为理解AI对就业和组织结构的影响提供了分析工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.20781v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming organizations, raising a fundamental organizational and economic question: when will a human employee be replaced by AI? We present an analytical model for studying Human--AI Task Allocation (HAT) in hierarchical organizations. A central feature of the HAT model is that it formally encodes the economic asymmetry between human skill acquisition and AI capability scaling. The HAT model allows us to derive how risk-adjusted costs, skills, organizational depth, deployment scale, strategic adapt…
items.why_zh: 为预测AI对就业的影响提供了分析模型，帮助组织和个人理解及应对替代风险。
items.why_en: It offers an analytical framework to predict AI-driven job substitution, aiding organizations and individuals in adaptation.

items.title_zh: Volve油田上基于实测井况的异常检测：构建标签、基线与双头模型
items.title_en: Grounded Well-Condition Anomaly Detection on the Volve Field: Constructed Labels, a Baseline, and a Dual-Head Model
items.summary_zh: 本文针对工业异常检测中公共基准与真实生产数据不匹配的问题，利用Equinor公开的Volve油田数据开展研究。与实验室测试台不同，真实油田只有传感器历史而无故障日志，因此方法需要自动生成标签，并要避免在过程中悄悄引入未明说的假设。作者构建了异常标签，并提出了一个基线与双头模型，以在真实数据上建立可靠的异常检测基线。这项工作强调了对真实场景中标签构建与模型设计的重视，对提升工业AI鲁棒性有参考意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.05685v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Most public benchmarks for machine-condition monitoring come from test rigs, where faults are induced on purpose and every event is known. Real production fields rarely offer that. They give you sensor histories with no fault log attached, which is exactly the situation where an anomaly-detection method has to invent its own labels, and where quiet assumptions can slip in unnoticed. We work with the open Volve field data released by Equinor and take two things seriously that such datasets usually skip. First, we build anomaly labels that are…
items.why_zh: 这项研究为缺乏故障标签的真实工业数据提供了可操作的异常检测路径和基线，有助于提升实际场景中AI监测的可靠性。
items.why_en: This work fills the gap between lab benchmarks and real industrial data, offering a practical baseline and dual-head model for anomaly detection without fault labels.

items.title_zh: 人工智能开发中的伦理实践：跨角色与地区的实证研究
items.title_en: Ethics Practices in AI Development: An Empirical Study Across Roles and Regions
items.summary_zh: 人工智能的快速发展引发对其伦理风险的关注。本文采用混合方法（统计与定性分析结合），对来自43个国家的414名AI开发相关人员进行了调查，覆盖AI经理、分析师、开发人员、质量保证人员等角色，考察他们在伦理认知、伦理实践和伦理知识方面的现状。该研究呈现了不同角色和地区在AI伦理落地方面的实践图景，为制定更有效的AI伦理规范与培训提供实证依据。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2508.09219v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent advances in AI applications have raised growing concerns about the need for ethical guidelines and regulations to mitigate the risks posed by these technologies. In this paper, we present a mixed-methods survey study - combining statistical and qualitative analyses - to examine the ethical perceptions, practices, and knowledge of individuals involved in various AI development roles. Our survey comprises 414 participants from 43 countries, representing various roles such as AI managers, analysts, developers, quality assurance prof…
items.why_zh: 该调查首次大规模提供了跨国家、跨角色的AI从业者伦理实践数据，有助于发现伦理准则与实际开发之间的差距。
items.why_en: This large-scale empirical survey reveals how AI ethics is perceived and practiced across roles and regions, helping to close the gap between guidelines and real-world development.

items.title_zh: 基于视觉语言模型与非线性多适配器的简单高效增量学习框架
items.title_en: A Simple Efficiency Incremental Learning Framework via Vision-Language Model with Nonlinear Multi-Adapters
items.summary_zh: 人工智能持续学习要求模型在学习新任务时不遗忘旧知识，而将视觉语言模型的零样本能力融入增量学习是一个重要思路。然而现有方法往往面临训练效率低、依赖内存库存储旧数据、需要强大的主干网络等问题。为此，本文提出一个简单高效的框架SimE，利用非线性多适配器整合视觉语言模型，力求在保持简洁性的同时应对上述挑战。该框架为更实用的增量学习系统提供了新的设计方向。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.11211v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Incremental Learning (IL) aims to learn new tasks while preserving previously acquired knowledge. Integrating the zero-shot learning capabilities of pre-trained vision-language models into IL methods has marked a significant advancement. However, these methods face three primary challenges: (1) the need for improved training efficiency; (2) reliance on a memory bank to store previous data; and (3) the necessity of a strong backbone to augment the model's capabilities. In this paper, we propose SimE, a Simple and Efficient framework that…
items.why_zh: 简化高效是增量学习落地的关键，SimE框架有望降低视觉语言模型在持续学习场景中的使用门槛。
items.why_en: SimE offers a more practical way to integrate vision-language models into incremental learning, addressing key bottlenecks of efficiency and memory.

items.title_zh: 用自主大语言模型研究循环优化专家设计的晶体图网络，实现带隙预测
items.title_en: Optimizing Expert-Designed Crystal Graph Networks for Band-Gap Prediction with an Autonomous LLM Research Loop
items.summary_zh: 材料性质预测是计算材料科学的核心问题之一。本文在MatBench带隙基准（含超过10万个晶体）上测试了自主智能体研究循环的潜力：一个通用编码智能体在MatBench带隙基准上自主构建了最准确的模型（无需外部预训练），从而实现了对专家设计的晶体图网络的优化。该工作展示了将自主AI用于科学发现的可能性，有望加速新材料的设计与筛选。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.29717v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Predicting a material's properties from its structure is a central, fast-advancing problem in computational materials science. A decade of work has produced standard public benchmarks and many published machine-learning models for the task (Dunn et al., 2020). The task's fixed metric and these baselines make it a natural setting for autonomous agent research (Karpathy, 2026). On the MatBench band-gap benchmark ($>$100k crystals), a general-purpose coding agent autonomously built the most accurate model trained without external pretraini…
items.why_zh: 该研究展示通用编码智能体能在材料科学基准上自主达到最优，为人工智能驱动的科学发现提供了有力的证据。
items.why_en: It shows that a general coding agent can autonomously outperform existing models on a materials science benchmark, highlighting the potential of AI-driven scientific discovery.

items.title_zh: 带背包约束的上下文赌博机的重新优化算法
items.title_en: Reoptimization Algorithms for Contextual Bandits with Knapsack Constraints
items.summary_zh: 本文针对带背包约束的上下文赌博机问题提出新的重新优化算法。这类问题中，产品由有限资源构成，决策者需要在线为客户分配产品，每次分配获得由未知线性函数加噪声定义的随机奖励。目标是在有限资源下共同学习并优化长期收益。该研究为在线分配与预算管理场景提供了理论保障的算法思路。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11383v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study new algorithms for Contextual Bandits with Knapsack. In these problems, there are finitely many types of customers, products, and resources. Each product is made from a fixed combination of resources, and resources have finite capacity. A decision maker must assign each arriving customer one out of a set of multiple possible products. Every assignment of a customer to a product will generate a random reward, which equals an unknown linear function of customer and product features, plus a noise term. The objective is to jointly learn the…
items.why_zh: 该问题涵盖在线广告、库存管理等多个实际场景，重新优化算法有助于在资源约束下做出更优决策。
items.why_en: This work tackles a broad class of online resource-allocation problems, with reoptimization methods promising better decisions under constraints.

items.title_zh: 基于LSTM和注意力建模的空气质量监测站模拟
items.title_en: Air Quality Station Simulation via LSTM and Attention-Based Modelling
items.summary_zh: 城市空气质量监测对公共健康至关重要，但硬件故障或断电可能造成数据缺失。本文提出一种基于LSTM和注意力机制的空气质量监测站模拟方法，通过学习历史监测数据来模拟站点的读数，从而在数据中断时提供估计或补充，保障监测网络的连续性和可解释性。该工作对提升空气质量监测系统的鲁棒性有积极意义。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11839v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Poor air quality in urban areas is driven by a complex chain of processes and presents a significant public health concern. To better understand and control the mechanisms that determine air quality, cities deploy networks of measurement stations, and launch initiatives for collecting denser data about the concentration of pollutants in the atmosphere. Extracting insights from the stations relies on their reliable and uninterrupted operation. However, hardware is susceptible to faults and black- outs that may result in data unavailability, which…
items.why_zh: 为空气质量监测数据缺失提供了一种可行的建模方案，有助于保障城市健康监测系统的连续性。
items.why_en: It offers a modelling approach to handle missing data in urban air quality networks, improving their resilience and continuity.

items.title_zh: 光晶体管增益的正向和逆向虚拟计量：面向小规模生产数据集的分层、不确定性感知方法
items.title_en: Forward and Inverse Virtual Metrology for Phototransistor Gain: A Hierarchical, Uncertainty-Aware Approach for Small Production Datasets
items.summary_zh: 半导体工艺开发周期长、成本高，如光晶体管增益只能在实际制造后测量。本文基于真实小规模生产数据（13至14次工艺运行），提出一个分层、不确定性感知的前向与逆向虚拟计量方法。该方法不仅从工艺参数预测器件增益，还能量化预测不确定性，在样本量很小的情况下为工艺优化和定制提供指导。这不同于依赖大数据的传统虚拟计量。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11868v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The customization, optimization and stabilization of the process flow of a silicon bipolar phototransistor commits months of cleanroom time before a finished device can be measured, so a model that predicts device gain from process parameters before a run has value out of proportion to its accuracy. We study this problem on a real fabrication history, thirteen to fourteen process runs of a single device: a small-sample, hierarchically structured setting unlike the large-corpus regime of conventional virtual metrology. Decomposing the variance of…
items.why_zh: 在极少样本下仍能预测器件性能并量化不确定性，对半导体制造这类高成本、长周期场景极具实用价值。
items.why_en: It provides a practical, uncertainty-aware solution for virtual metrology in small-sample industrial settings, potentially saving months of fabrication time.

items.title_zh: DCM赌博机：多人信息不对称级联赌博机中的多次点击
items.title_en: DCM Bandits: Multiplayer Information Asymmetric Cascading Bandits for Multiple Clicks
items.summary_zh: 在在线推荐与搜索场景中，多个用户同时面对一个共享排序列表，并可能点击多个结果，这给学习最优策略带来困难。本文将依赖点击模型（DCM）推广到多人信息不对称环境，系统分析行为不对称和奖励不对称下的选择策略，并针对至少存在一种非对称性的三种设置给出了亚线性遗憾上界。作者进一步指出，匹配的信息论下界仍是开放问题，并对小规模情形进行了讨论。该工作为多人共享列表场景下的在线学习提供了理论支撑。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11873v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we extend the Dependent Click Model (DCM) Bandits to a multiplayer information-asymmetric setting, where multiple agents interact with a shared ranked list and may observe multiple clicks per session, introducing new challenges for selection strategies. We study asymmetry in (1) actions and (2) rewards, providing sublinear regret guarantees for three settings where at least one asymmetry is present. Establishing matching information-theoretic lower bounds for these settings is left as an open problem. We further show that for small…
items.why_zh: 该研究推进了多人共享列表与多次点击场景下的在线决策理论，对推荐系统和搜索引擎优化具有指导意义。
items.why_en: It advances the theory of online learning in shared-ranking, multi-click environments, with direct implications for recommendation and search systems.

items.title_zh: 榛子X射线图像自动二分类：质量评估的深度学习基准
items.title_en: Automated binary classification of hazelnut X-ray images: A deep-learning benchmark for quality assessment
items.summary_zh: 该研究构建了一个用于榛子质量二分类（健康与缺陷）的基准测试，基于799张分割后的单颗榛子X射线图像（224×224像素，灰度），这些图像被划分为101个采集单元。非破坏性X射线成像能够揭示仅靠外部检查难以发现的内部缺陷，但类别间细微的放射学差异、显著的类别不平衡以及有限的标注数据，使得自动化解释仍然具有挑战性。论文提出了七种单模型配置和十种集成配置（原文截断）作为对比，旨在系统评估不同深度学习模型在此任务上的表现。该基准为榛子内部品质的无损检测提供了统一参考，有助于推动农产品质量评估自动化。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.11759v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Non-destructive X-ray imaging can reveal internal hazelnut defects that are difficult to detect by external inspection alone; however, automated interpretation remains challenging because of subtle radiographic differences among classes, marked class imbalance, and limited annotated data. Here, we present a benchmark for binary hazelnut quality classification (healthy versus defective) based on 799 segmented single-kernel X-ray images (224 x 224 pixels, grayscale), grouped into 101 acquisition units. Seven single-model configurations and ten pr…
items.why_zh: 它首次为榛子X射线图像质量分类提供了系统性的深度学习基准，有助于推动农产品无损检测的标准化与自动化。
items.why_en: It provides the first systematic deep-learning benchmark for hazelnut quality classification from X-ray images, advancing standardized automated quality assessment in agriculture.

items.title_zh: 探针揭示的真相：MedCLIP中真实世界的胸部X射线捷径
items.title_en: Look What the Probes Dragged In! Real-World Chest X-ray Shortcuts in MedCLIP
items.summary_zh: 视觉语言模型（如基于CLIP的方法）在医学人工智能中已达到最先进水平，但近期研究显示这类模型仍易受“捷径”（shortcuts）影响。该研究专门调查了真实世界中的捷径如何在医疗CLIP模型MedCLIP及其视觉编码器（冻结的ResNet-50）的不同层中表现出来。研究者将17个线性分类探针附加到ResNet-50的中间层，并在三个不同的数据集（原文截断）上训练它们，以分析捷径在模型内部的分布。这项工作有助于理解医学视觉语言模型的脆弱性，并为提高其鲁棒性提供线索。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.12086v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-language models, such as contrastive language-image pre-training (CLIP)-based approaches, have reached state-of-the-art (SOTA) results in medical artificial intelligence. However, recent work reveals that CLIP-based models remain vulnerable to shortcuts. We investigate how real-world shortcuts manifest across different layers of the medical CLIP-based model, MedCLIP, and its vision encoder, a frozen ResNet-50. items.why_zh: 该研究首次系统剖析医学CLIP模型中真实捷径的跨层表现，对提升医学影像AI的可靠性和安全性至关重要。

items.title_zh: ADEPT：深度学习测试充分性的统一框架
items.title_en: ADEPT: A Unified Framework for Deep Learning Test Adequacy
items.summary_zh: 过去十年间，研究者提出了许多深度学习测试充分性指标，从不同角度描述测试数据集的充分性，例如神经元激活行为、潜在特征覆盖率、决策边界探索等。然而，这些指标通常以独立研究原型的形式发布，在安装、预处理、执行流程和配置机制上差异显著，导致其难以被复现、比较和在实际研究中采用。为解决这一问题，论文提出了ADEPT，一个统一的深度学习测试充分性框架，旨在整合现有指标并提供一致的工作流。该框架有望大幅降低研究者的使用门槛，促进测试充分性指标的标准化和广泛应用。

items.why_zh: 该框架解决了深度学习测试充分性指标长期存在的碎片化和不可复现问题，对提升AI模型测试效率与可信度有直接推动。
items.why_en: ADEPT unifies fragmented deep learning test adequacy metrics, reducing reproducibility barriers and enabling broader adoption in AI testing.

items.title_zh: OrderMoE：基于专家相似性的分布式边缘MoE推理
items.title_en: OrderMoE: An expert similarity driven distributed edge MoE inference
items.summary_zh: 混合专家模型（MoE）因能以适中的计算成本扩展大语言模型而日益普及，但在资源受限、带宽有限的边缘基础设施上部署MoE推理仍然面临挑战。现有的分布式MoE服务方法主要依赖精确的专家放置、缓存、复制或通信调度，却忽略了专家间的功能相似性——这实际上提供了减少跨服务器令牌传输的机会。为此，论文提出了OrderMoE，一种利用专家相似性来优化分布式边缘MoE推理的方法。通过智能地组织专家并减少不必要的网络通信，OrderMoE有望提升边缘场景下MoE模型的推理效率。
